# Component Inventory — Web

*Generated by the BMad document-project workflow — deep scan, 2026-07-17.*

## Overview

`apps/web` is the Telar cockpit: a Next.js 16 (canary) App Router app rendering loom, project, session and settings surfaces. Its UI code lives in four places:

- [`components/ui/`](../apps/web/components/ui) — 28 generic shadcn primitives (Button, Dialog, Select, Sidebar, …), each a thin wrapper around a `@base-ui/react` headless component plus Tailwind classes. Framework-agnostic to the Telar domain; safe to reuse anywhere.
- [`components/ai-elements/`](../apps/web/components/ai-elements) — 5 chat/markdown building blocks (Conversation, Message, PromptInput, MarkdownPre, Shimmer) adapted from the community "ai-elements" pattern for the Vercel AI SDK. Streamdown-backed markdown rendering lives here.
- [`components/common/`](../apps/web/components/common), [`components/looms/`](../apps/web/components/looms), [`components/session/`](../apps/web/components/session), [`components/projects/`](../apps/web/components/projects), [`components/settings/`](../apps/web/components/settings), [`components/dock/`](../apps/web/components/dock), [`components/app-sidebar.tsx`](../apps/web/components/app-sidebar.tsx) — domain-specific composites that render loom/thread/session/project state. These import `ui/` and `ai-elements/` primitives and `@telar/core` types (`Loom`, `WorkUnitState`, `Charter`, …); they are not portable outside Telar's domain model but are the components a new cockpit feature will most often extend or copy.
- [`lib/demo-gallery/`](../apps/web/lib/demo-gallery) — a frozen, standalone gallery of UI **exploration** entries (`app/demo-gallery/`), organized into "lanes" (`lists`, `loom`, `project`, `ultra`). Per its own header comment in [`lib/demo-gallery/registry.ts`](../apps/web/lib/demo-gallery/registry.ts), this is a "FROZEN REGISTRY CONTRACT" for design review, not the production surface — useful as a reference for interaction ideas but not a source of reusable components without re-verifying against `components/`.

Total component surface: 28 `ui/` primitives, 5 `ai-elements/` primitives, 24 `looms/` files, 12 `session/` files, 13 `projects/` files, 9 `settings/` files, 3 `dock/` files, 5 `common/` files, plus `app-sidebar.tsx`. The largest domain files are [`components/session/session-view.tsx`](../apps/web/components/session/session-view.tsx) (3325 lines), [`components/looms/god-view.tsx`](../apps/web/components/looms/god-view.tsx) (1883 lines), [`components/settings/mcp-settings.tsx`](../apps/web/components/settings/mcp-settings.tsx) (1524 lines), [`components/ai-elements/prompt-input.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ai-elements/prompt-input.tsx) (1465 lines), [`components/app-sidebar.tsx`](../apps/web/components/app-sidebar.tsx) (1186 lines) and [`components/looms/thread-drawer.tsx`](../apps/web/components/looms/thread-drawer.tsx) (1171 lines) — each is a page-scale composite, not a single widget.

## Design System

**Base primitives — `@base-ui/react` (not Radix).** [`components.json`](../apps/web/components.json) configures the shadcn CLI with `"style": "base-nova"`, `iconLibrary: "lucide"`, `baseColor: "neutral"`, `cssVariables: true`. Every interactive `ui/` component wraps a `@base-ui/react/*` headless primitive: `accordion`, `avatar`, `button`, `collapsible`, `dialog` (also powers `sheet.tsx`), `input`, `menu` (powers `dropdown-menu.tsx`), `popover`, `preview-card` (powers `hover-card.tsx`), `progress`, `scroll-area`, `select`, `separator`, `switch`, `tabs`, `tooltip`, plus the `merge-props`/`use-render` utilities used by `badge.tsx`, `button-group.tsx`, and `sidebar.tsx` to build polymorphic (`render={...}`) components. [`components/ui/command.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ui/command.tsx) is the one exception, wrapping `cmdk` directly.

**Variants — `class-variance-authority` (cva).** Used in 7 files: [`ui/button.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ui/button.tsx) (`variant`: default/outline/secondary/ghost/destructive/link; `size`: default/xs/sm/lg/icon/icon-xs/icon-sm/icon-lg), [`ui/badge.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ui/badge.tsx), [`ui/alert.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ui/alert.tsx), [`ui/button-group.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ui/button-group.tsx), [`ui/input-group.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ui/input-group.tsx), [`ui/sidebar.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ui/sidebar.tsx), [`ui/tabs.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ui/tabs.tsx). New variant surfaces should follow this pattern — a `cva(...)` call exporting `xVariants` plus a typed `VariantProps<typeof xVariants>` prop.

**Styling — Tailwind CSS v4, CSS-first config.** No `tailwind.config.*` file exists; all theme tokens live in [`app/globals.css`](../apps/web/app/globals.css) via `@theme inline` and `:root`/`.dark` OKLCH custom properties (`--background`, `--primary`, `--sidebar`, `--chart-1..5`, `--radius` and derived `--radius-sm..4xl`, etc.), imported alongside `tailwindcss`, `tw-animate-css`, and the `shadcn` package's own `shadcn/tailwind.css` base layer. Dark mode is a `.dark` class variant (`@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))`), toggled by [`components/settings/theme-provider.tsx`](../apps/web/components/settings/theme-provider.tsx) (inline `THEME_INIT_SCRIPT` avoids a flash-of-wrong-theme by reading `localStorage["telar-ui-prefs"]` before hydration). Class merging goes through [`lib/utils.ts`](../apps/web/lib/utils.ts) `cn()` (`clsx` + `tailwind-merge`) — always use `cn()` rather than raw string concatenation when composing classNames.

**Icons — `lucide-react`** (`^1.23.0`). 75 import sites across `components/` and `app/`. Icons are passed as component references (e.g. `icon: LucideIcon` props on `EmptyState`, `StatusBadge`) rather than hardcoded per call site, so icon+tone pairings stay centralized (see `components/looms/status.tsx`'s `statusVisual()` and `TONE_ICON` map). [`components/session/provider-icon.tsx`](../apps/web/components/session/provider-icon.tsx) is the one exception: it inlines real brand marks (Anthropic/Claude, OpenAI Codex) rather than pulling a brand-icon dependency.

**Motion — `motion` (Framer Motion successor), used sparingly.** Only one direct import site: [`components/ai-elements/shimmer.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ai-elements/shimmer.tsx), which mask-animates a `motion.span` to sweep a "brightened" text band across a label (used for "working…" states) rather than animating opacity, to avoid a documented WebKit renderer crash on fixed-position fade animations (see the `[class*="animate-in"]` disable rule in `app/globals.css`). Enter/exit keyframe animations (`animate-in`/`animate-out`) are globally disabled for the same WebKit-crash reason; `animate-pulse`/`animate-spin` remain available.

**Markdown/chat rendering — `streamdown` + `@streamdown/*` plugins.** [`components/ai-elements/message.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ai-elements/message.tsx) wraps the `Streamdown` component (exported as `MessageResponse`) with the `cjk`, `code`, `math`, and `mermaid` `@streamdown/*` plugins, plus a custom `MarkdownPre` (from [`components/ai-elements/code-block.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ai-elements/code-block.tsx)) for fenced code blocks with a copy button. This is the app's one markdown renderer — consumed directly by chat messages and, per code comments in `components/dock/dock.tsx` and `components/projects/git-tab-remote-detail.tsx`, reused for rendering GitHub issue/PR bodies and dock content so markdown always looks the same across the app.

**Scroll-to-bottom — `use-stick-to-bottom`.** [`components/ai-elements/conversation.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ai-elements/conversation.tsx) wraps `StickToBottom`/`useStickToBottomContext` for the chat scroll container, with a floating "scroll to bottom" `ArrowDownIcon` button.

**Carousel — `embla-carousel-react`**, wrapped by [`components/ui/carousel.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ui/carousel.tsx). No other embla usage found.

| McpSettings | [components/settings/mcp-settings.tsx](../apps/web/components/settings/mcp-settings.tsx) (1524 lines) | Full MCP server configuration + OAuth connect UI | No — page-scale |
| NotificationsSettings | [components/settings/notifications-settings.tsx](../apps/web/components/settings/notifications-settings.tsx) | Notification preferences | No |
| SessionRuntimeHost | [components/dock/session-runtime-host.tsx](../apps/web/components/dock/session-runtime-host.tsx) (422 lines) | Hosts a live session's runtime inside the dock | No — dock-internal |

## Reuse Guidance

When adding a cockpit feature, reach for primitives in this order:

1. **Start in `components/ui/`.** For any generic interaction (button, dialog, select, tooltip, popover, tabs, badge, card, form input), a `@base-ui/react`-backed primitive already exists here — do not hand-roll a new modal or dropdown. Compose variants with the existing `cva` config rather than adding one-off className overrides; if a new visual variant is needed, extend the relevant `xVariants` object in place.
2. **For lists** (looms list, projects list, any new "browse N things" page), reuse [`components/common/list-controls.tsx`](../apps/web/components/common/list-controls.tsx) (`SearchField`, `Chip`, `GroupHeader`, `SortSelect`, `StatTile`) and [`components/common/empty-state.tsx`](../apps/web/components/common/empty-state.tsx) rather than building bespoke filter/empty-state UI — these already carry the app's spacing and typography conventions.
3. **For anything rendering a `Loom`/`WorkUnitState`**, use [`components/common/state-badge.tsx`](../apps/web/components/common/state-badge.tsx), [`components/looms/status.tsx`](../apps/web/components/looms/status.tsx) (`statusVisual`/`StatusBadge`/`TONE_ICON`) and [`components/looms/loom-card.tsx`](../apps/web/components/looms/loom-card.tsx) as the canonical state→color/icon mapping. Two independent state-color palettes in the UI is a known anti-pattern the code comments explicitly guard against (see `loom-card.tsx`'s `WeaveChip` comment on indigo being reserved and never doubling up with the amber state rail).
4. **For chat/markdown surfaces**, reuse `Message`/`MessageContent`/`MessageResponse` from [`components/ai-elements/message.tsx`](../apps/web/components/ai-elements/message.tsx) (Streamdown-backed) rather than adding a second markdown renderer — it is already the shared renderer for chat, the dock, and GitHub issue/PR bodies (`components/projects/git-tab-remote-detail.tsx`).
5. **For any collapsible tool-call/transcript row**, reuse [`components/session/tool-step.tsx`](../apps/web/components/session/tool-step.tsx) — it is already shared between the session chat view and the loom agent-view transcript specifically to keep the two from drifting.
6. **Treat `components/looms/*`, `components/session/session-view.tsx`, `components/projects/git-tab*.tsx`, and `components/settings/*` as page-scale composites**, not reusable widgets — they are wired to specific `@telar/core` domain types and specific routes. When a new feature needs "something like the thread drawer" or "something like the acceptance panel," read the target file's own top-of-file comment (most domain files carry one explaining intent and constraints) before extending it, and prefer extracting a new shared primitive into `common/` over copy-pasting a domain file.
7. **Do not use `lib/demo-gallery/` as a source of production components.** It is an explicitly frozen exploration registry (`lib/demo-gallery/registry.ts`) for comparing UI variants side by side, not the shipping surface — its fixtures and components (`lib/demo-gallery/**`) are useful for interaction ideas only and must be re-verified/rebuilt against the real `components/` tree before reuse.
8. **Icons**: always `lucide-react`, passed as component references rather than JSX where a prop expects one (`icon: LucideIcon`), so tone/color centralization (e.g. `TONE_ICON`) keeps working.
9. **Motion**: reach for the `motion` package only when CSS transitions/`animate-pulse`/`animate-spin` are insufficient, and check `components/ai-elements/shimmer.tsx`'s comment about the WebKit fixed-position fade crash before adding any opacity-based enter/exit animation — the app currently disables `animate-in`/`animate-out` globally for this reason.
